description: Playwright suite for TEST-PLAN.md (TC-* ids are in the test titles)

scripts.race:gif: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p=require('path'),c=require('child_process');const dir=p.join(process.cwd(),'test-report','race-ui');const a=p.join(dir,'race-ui-A.webm'),b=p.join(dir,'race-ui-B.webm');if(!f.existsSync(a)||!f.existsSync(b)){console.error('[race:gif] FAILED: no recordings in '+dir+' - run this from the e2e folder after: npm run test:race:ui');process.exit(1);}const cands=[process.env.FFMPEG,'ffmpeg'];for(const r of [process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH,p.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA||'','ms-playwright'),p.join(process.env.USERPROFILE||process.env.HOME||'','.cache','ms-playwright'),p.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','playwright-core','.local-browsers')]){try{for(const q=p.join(r,d,n);if(f.existsSync(q))cands.push(q);}}}catch(e){}}let ff='';const seen=[];for(const q of cands.filter(Boolean)){const m=c.spawnSync(q,['-hide_banner','-muxers'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(m.status!==0)continue;seen.push(q);if(String(m.stdout).indexOf(' gif ')===-1)continue;const fc='[0:v]fps=8,scale=520:-2:flags=lanczos,pad=iw+6:ih:0:0:gray[a];[1:v]fps=8,scale=520:-2:flags=lanczos[b];[a][b]hstack=inputs=2,split[x][y];[x]palettegen=stats_mode=diff[pl];[y][pl]paletteuse=dither=bayer';const r=c.spawnSync(ff,['-y','-loglevel','error','-i',a,'-i',b,'-filter_complex',fc,out],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0){console.error('[race:gif] FAILED: '+ff+' exited
